{"action": "run_sql", "sql": "WITH RECURSIVE bom_tree AS (
  -- Start with the top-level product
  SELECT 
    p.product_id AS assembly_id,
    p.product_number AS assembly_number,
    b.component_id,
    pr.product_number AS component_number,
    b.per_assembly_qty,
    b.bom_level,
    b.per_assembly_qty AS total_qty,
    1 AS depth
  FROM product p
  JOIN bill_of_materials b ON p.product_id = b.assembly_id
  JOIN product pr ON b.component_id = pr.product_id
  WHERE p.product_number = 'BK-T44U-46'
    AND b.start_date <= '2025-06-30' 
    AND (b.end_date IS NULL OR b.end_date >= '2025-06-30')
  
  UNION ALL
  
  -- Recurse into sub-assemblies
  SELECT 
    p.product_id AS assembly_id,
    p.product_number AS assembly_number,
    b.component_id,
    pr.product_number AS component_number,
    b.per_assembly_qty,
    b.bom_level,
    bt.total_qty * b.per_assembly_qty AS total_qty,
    bt.depth + 1 AS depth
  FROM bom_tree bt
  JOIN product p ON bt.component_id = p.product_id
  JOIN bill_of_materials b ON p.product_id = b.assembly_id
  JOIN product pr ON b.component_id = pr.product_id
  WHERE p.make_flag = true
    AND b.start_date <= '2025-06-30' 
    AND (b.end_date IS NULL OR b.end_date >= '2025-06-30')
)
SELECT 
  component_number,
  SUM(total_qty) AS total_quantity_needed
FROM bom_tree
WHERE component_number = 'LR-2398'
GROUP BY component_number"}

    FROM bill_of_materials b

      AND b.assembly_id IS NOT NULL
